title: PROCEDURE AND STATUS FOR INDENTING AND ALLOCATION OF BREEDER SEED THROUGH NSAI AND STRENGTH & CHALLENGES OF SATHI PORTAL OF DA&FW
content: Dear Sir, National Seed Association of India (NSAI is organizing a workshop on "PROCEDURE AND STATUS FOR INDENTING AND ALLOCATION OF BREEDER SEED THROUGH NSAI AND STRENGTH & CHALLENGES OF SATHI PORTAL OF DA&FW" on 31st May, 2024 from 9:30 AM to 1:00 PM at NASC Lecture Hall, Pusa, New Delhi for the benefit of Indian seed industry. This workshop will be mainly focused on the issues related to the Breeder seed indent and allocation and strength & challenges of SATHI Portal. This workshop will educate on the system of Breeder seed indenting and will also help in resolving various difficulties faced by NSAI members companies in indenting and allocation of Breeder seed. We have invited the most experienced and learned experts from the DA&FW and ICAR to deliver the presentations and provide the latest information on the subject. NSAI is pleased to invite you to participate in this workshop. The program details and form are attached with the mail. Kindly send the duly filled form to us on or before 28th May 2024. The details of the workshop are given below: Date: May 31st, 2024 Time: 9:30 AM â€“ 1:00 PM Venue: NASC Lecture Hall, Pusa, New Delhi Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeUXMV-y5DzvAc2v1sUb59F4g5EnWIBfkiNUdd5IuLZWAGqbA/viewform?usp=sf_link Breeder Seed - Workshop Registration Form For any query please contact us: Dr Deepanker Pandey, Assistant Director Mob: 9719291820 Thank you & looking forward to your participation in the workshop. Warm Regards, R K Trivedi Executive Director National Seed Association of India

title: National Workshop on Strategic IP Management for Agriculture
content: “National Workshop on Strategic IP Management for Agriculture”, is to be conducted by us from 25-27 April 2013 in Hyderabad. NAARM is the Institutional Partner and SEEDSMEN Association –AP is our Associate Partner for the initiative. As you must be very well aware of the fact that Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) is a non-government, not-for-profit, industry led and industry managed organization, playing a proactive role in India's development process. Founded over 116 years ago, it is India's premier business association, with a direct membership of over 8500 organizations from the private as well as public sectors, including SMEs and MNCs, and an indirect membership of over 90,000 companies from around 400 national and regional sectoral associations. CII works to create and sustain an environment conducive to the growth of industry in India, partnering industry and government alike through advisory and consultative processes. Andhra Pradesh Technology Development & Promotion Centre (APTDC) is an organization promoted by the Government and CII as a one-stop shop for providing services to industry in technology and Intellectual Property Rights by networking with global experts to fuel knowledge driven the industrial growth. CII-APTDC, as its ongoing initiative of building strong IP ecosystem in India through capacity building of Industry in IPR, is organising this workshop on IP Management for the Agri. sector.
